entry.title: Chiplet photonics startup samples pluggable laser engines
entry.summary: A chiplet photonics supplier sampled external laser engines aimed at co-packaged optics modules. The design separates laser maintenance from switch ASIC packaging and targets lower thermal load in AI cluster fabrics.

entry.title: Foundry update expands advanced packaging for AI accelerators
entry.summary: The foundry added capacity for chiplet assembly, high-bandwidth memory integration, and interposer packaging. The update gives accelerator vendors more room to combine compute dies, memory, and networking interfaces.

entry.title: Sparse inference ASIC reports higher TOPS per watt
entry.content: The inference ASIC uses structured sparsity, low-voltage memory, and near-memory scheduling to improve throughput per watt. Operators are evaluating it for edge AI and constrained data center racks where power delivery is the bottleneck.
